She holds a neon yellow pleated fabric sleeve in her right hand and a reddish-orange one in her left. Behind her, a clean white surface and a dark textured wall are visible. (2) A man with a shaved head, wearing a green and black striped button-down shirt and matching shorts, joins the woman in the frame. The man begins to place the reddish-orange sleeve over his eyes like a superhero mask. The scene cuts rapidly as they interact; he then stretches the sleeve over his head like a balaclava. The woman stands beside him, smiling and occasionally adjusting her hair. (3) The man uses the yellow sleeve as a hand puppet, moving his hand inside the fabric to mimic a mouth. The setting is a modern living room featuring a large television screen, a yellow sculptural chair, and a sliding glass door. (4) The man attempts to loop the sleeve through his shirt buttons as a fashion accessory. The woman leans against the yellow chair, watching his demonstration. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the sequence.
